pages.title: The Longest Motion
pages.text: Every character carries their own set of Supers. Sayuri has no {input:641236}, but she does have the longest common motion in the game: {input:6321463214}. Don't let the length scare you - it reads just like every smaller motion. Roll through the directions and finish on the attack button.

pages.title: Overlapping Motions
pages.text: Sayuri also packs a {input:2141236} Super. When two motions overlap like this, the game trusts your most recent directions - so a clean, continuous input always gives you the move you meant.
